sources.entry: Mindustry - Factorio-like tower defense game. Build production chains to gather more resources, and build complex facilities. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Java

summary.one_liner: Mindustry is an automation tower defense RTS game written in Java, where players build production chains and complex facilities.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Mindustry as an automation tower defense RTS written in Java. It links to a Trello board, a wiki, and Javadoc. It explains how to build the game from source with Gradle: desktop run/dist tasks, a sprite packing tool, server builds, and an Android debug APK. It requires JDK 17 and says other JDK versions will not work. It also documents that the mindustry.gen package is generated at build time and should not be edited by hand. The README itself does not describe gameplay in detail; the awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a Factorio-like tower defense game for building production chains to gather resources.
use_cases: playing a factory-building tower defense game
compiling a Java game from source
building an Android APK of a strategy game
contributing to a Java game codebase
how_to_run: Install JDK 17 (other JDK versions will not work)
Build a desktop jar: ./gradlew desktop:dist (output in desktop/build/libs/Mindustry.jar)
Build a server jar: ./gradlew server:dist (output in server/build/libs/server-release.jar)
Android: ./gradlew android:assembleDebug (requires Android SDK with ANDROID_HOME set)
notable: Automation-focused tower defense RTS with production chains
Pre-built bleeding-edge builds generated for every commit
Separate desktop, server, and Android build targets
Sprite packing tool via gradlew tools:pack
Good-first-issue pointers to a separate Mindustry-Suggestions repository
caveats: Requires JDK 17 specifically; other JDK versions will not work
First Gradle build may take several minutes to download files
Android build requires manual SDK setup and developer mode on the device
